datasets.name: 530b350d
queryLines:
SELECT anio, mes, nombre_mes, make_date(anio, mes, 1) AS fecha, total_reservas, total_viajeros,
       ventas_totales, ticket_promedio, gasto_promedio_persona, pagos_recibidos
FROM catalog_dev.golden.kpi_ventas_mensuales

datasets.name: f9e74caa
queryLines:
SELECT * FROM catalog_dev.golden.kpi_clientes
ORDER BY gasto_total DESC
LIMIT 10

datasets.name: 5ae80897
queryLines:
SELECT * FROM catalog_dev.golden.kpi_hoteles
ORDER BY ventas_totales DESC
LIMIT 10

datasets.name: 48039ae2
queryLines:
SELECT ruta, SUM(reservas) AS reservas, SUM(pasajeros) AS pasajeros
FROM catalog_dev.golden.kpi_vuelos
GROUP BY ruta
ORDER BY reservas DESC
LIMIT 10
